cards.text: Jesus had sent the Twelve out to proclaim the kingdom of God and to heal the sick (Luke 9:1-2). Now the apostles are back, and they report to Him everything they've done, and friend, my whole report after a long day is "I dropped my hat in the dough AGAIN." Then Jesus takes them away privately, just Him and the Twelve.

cards.question: Jesus takes the apostles away privately. What town does He withdraw to?

cards.text: But the crowds find out and follow Him. That's like putting your phone on silent and the whole group chat shows up at your front door.

cards.question: When the crowds show up, Jesus sends them away.
Jesus welcomes the crowds and speaks to them about the kingdom of God. He also ___ the ones who are sick.

cards.text: As the day nears its end, out in a desolate place, the Twelve all come to Jesus together. Twelve people walking up at once, friend, that's not a visit, that's a MEETING.

cards.question: As the day ends, what do the Twelve ask Jesus to do with the crowd?

answers.text: Send them off to find food and lodging
Have them share the food they brought
Keep teaching them through the night

cards.text: But Jesus tells them, "You give them something to eat." I bet twelve jaws just dropped at the same time.

cards.question: Jesus tells the Twelve to give the crowd something to eat. How much food do they say they have?

answers.text: Seven loaves and a few fish

cards.text: They say the only other way is to go buy food for all these people, and there are about five thousand men. I once ran out of sprinkles halfway through ONE tray and had to sit down.

cards.question: With about five thousand men out there, what does Jesus tell the disciples to have the crowd do?

answers.text: Sit down in groups of about fifty
Stand in lines of about a hundred
Walk to the nearest village together

cards.question: The disciples get the whole crowd seated in groups, just like Jesus told them.

cards.text: Then Jesus takes the five loaves and the two fish into His hands.

cards.question: Before He breaks the five loaves and the two fish, Jesus looks up to ___ and speaks a blessing.
After Jesus breaks the loaves and fish, He sets the food in front of the people Himself.
About five thousand men, and only five loaves and two fish. They all ate and were ___.

cards.text: Then the disciples go around picking up the broken pieces left over. In the Millers' kitchen, where I used to live, nothing was ever left over, because the whole family crowded in to steal the dough.

cards.question: The disciples gather up the broken pieces left over. How many basketfuls do they pick up?
